title: Eagle Lake sphere answers SOS and chases canoe
place_text: Eagle Lake near Smith Brook campsite, Allagash Waterway, Maine

tellings.quote: I see this aspurn tablets sized white circle and I'm thinking that is the freaking moon you But then I noticed that it was moving

right there it was right behind us and I was like oh Christ we are not going to make it back and then that's the last thing I remembered until we stopped at the our canoe at the went up on the shore of the campsite and
tellings.difference: Told by Jim Weiner rather than Foltz, and adds that he remembers nothing from the sphere closing in until they reached shore.
tellings.link_reason: The same Eagle Lake moment as telling 1, with the sphere closing in on the canoe, told now by Jim Weiner, whose memory breaks off at that point.

as_told.title: Memory gap as sphere closes in behind the canoe

plain: Charlie Foltz says that in 1976, while camping on Eagle Lake in Maine's Allagash Waterway with Jim Weiner, Jack Weiner and Chuck Rak, he saw a small white circle he first took for the moon, until it started moving. As the story goes, the glowing sphere answered their SOS signal and chased their canoe, and Jim Weiner adds that he remembers nothing from the moment it was right behind them until they reached the shore of their campsite. If true, it would point to missing time and possibly an abduction.
